reasons.text: This AI estimate, not GTO or solver output, assigns AA 90% all-in, 10% call and 0% fold. Shoving emphasizes premium value against BTN's 26BB cold four-bet with HJ still live; calling retains an inducing option but permits HJ to continue. AA removes opposing AA and AK, but also ace-wheel bluffs.

reasons.text: AKs folds 10%, calls 65% and goes all-in 25%. Suited realization supports calling despite being out of position with HJ able to reopen; premium rank blockers support some aggression, while BTN's premium-heavy range warrants restraint. The ace also removes some wheel bluffs.

reasons.text: AQs folds 100%. Removing AA, AK and QQ does not overcome AK domination and overpair pressure against BTN's cold four-bet, especially with HJ still able to act; suitedness alone does not justify continuing.
reasons.text_ja: AQsは100%フォールドです。AA・AK・QQを減らしても、BTNのコールド4ベットに対するAKからのドミネーションとオーバーペアの圧力は補えず、HJもまだ行動できます。スーテッドであるだけでは続行の根拠になりません。

reasons.text: AJs folds 100%. Against BTN's premium-heavy 26BB range, an ace pair can be dominated by AK, while jack-pair strength is inadequate; suited potential does not offset HJ's remaining action.
reasons.text_ja: AJsは100%フォールドです。BTNの強いハンド中心の26BBレンジに対し、AのペアはAKにドミネートされ得て、Jのペアも強さが足りません。スーテッドの可能性では、HJの行動が残るリスクを補えません。
